# sovereign-study-commons-india
> AIR < 10 FSRS-5 Continuous Memory Engine & Sovereign Exam Derivation Harness

## Quick Overview
- Domain: Cognitive Science & Spaced Repetition
- Performance: 0.90 Target Retention • 50,000+ Evidence Spans
- Agent Discovery Standard: llms.txt compliant for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini Spark.

## Core Capabilities
1. High-throughput zero-copy serialization and stream routing.
2. Verified physical provenance and reproducible micro-benchmarks.
3. Offline-first local execution with Apple Silicon M1 hardware acceleration.
